title: Unexpected Alliance
description: A zombie cavalry regiment, coolies afraid of elite monsters, skeletons
body:
The mod adds an enhanced Creeper with a 1% spawn rate. It has high armor and drops a variety of loot, and its armor decreases with each attack it takes.

There’s also a Zombie Knight Legion consisting of 4 zombie knights — a true infantry-tank coordinated squad!

And a small skeleton inspired by Diablo 2 (D2), the Nether Doll (or “Nether Grandfather” as a playful nickname).

Additionally, 4 enchantments have been added that let you harness the abilities of these monsters:

Energy Shield: Inspired by the enhanced Creeper. Grants a high amount of armor that gradually decreases with each attack you take. When you haven't taken damage for a while, it slowly regenerates back to its maximum value.

Totem Blast: Also from the enhanced Creeper. When a death totem is triggered, it creates an explosion whose power scales with the enchantment level, clearing nearby mobs.

Necrotic Resurrection: Upon killing a mob, summons a friendly Stygian Doll on your side. Though its stats are modest, its death explosion can wipe out large groups of enemies!

模组添加了一个增强的苦力怕1%生成概率，拥有高额护甲和丰富的掉落物，随着攻击护甲越来越低；还有一个僵尸骑士团，拥有4个僵尸骑士，步坦协同小子！
一个灵感来自暗黑2（D2）的小骷髅，冥河娃娃（冥河爷爷）
还添加了4个附魔，让你拥有这些怪物的特性
能量护盾：来自强化苦力怕，让你拥有一个高额的护甲值，但是随着攻击逐渐减少，一段时间不受到伤害时逐渐恢复到最高值
图腾爆破：来自强化苦力怕，触发死亡图腾时根据等级造成爆炸，为你清理附近的生物
亡灵复生：击杀生物时生成友方的冥河娃娃，虽然属性不高，但是死亡自爆能清理大片怪物！
